title: backend
summary: A Python backend offering anonymization and synthetic-data-generation utilities for education, healthcare, and finance datasets, combining tools like Presidio and SMOTE with tabular synthesis. It imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) alongside the standalone ctgan package to generate synthetic data for anonymization workflows.
